display_long_description:
Full throttle. No brakes.

Climb into the driver's seat of a speeding ambulance and take on an endless three-lane highway packed with traffic. Crazy Traffic VR puts you inside the cabin: reach out, grab the steering wheel with one or both hands and swerve between cars at full speed.

DRIVE YOUR WAY • Grab a real 3D steering wheel with your hands, or steer with the left thumbstick. Both work at any time. • Hold the right trigger to fire the nitro and feel the speed. • Arcade steering for maximum comfort, or Realistic steering for full control.

WRECK THE TRAFFIC • Ram regular cars off the road to earn coins. • Never touch a truck or a bus: one hit and your run is over. • Watch your health, your nitro and your distance on the dashboard instrument cluster.

THREE HIGHWAYS, THREE CHALLENGES • Desert, Jungle and Snow, each with its own distance record. • Easy: no damage, relaxed driving. • Normal: crashes hurt, 2x coins. • Hard: crashes hurt and the clock is ticking, 3x coins.

UPGRADE YOUR AMBULANCE • Two ambulances: start with one and unlock the second with the coins you earn. • Ten levels each of Speed, Health and Nitro upgrades.
